title: Bienvenut to "Vostre Altesse" (the duc de Nevers?), Paris, 28 February 1590 (BnF fr. 3623 no. 23; DECODE R9453)

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3623 no. 23, ff. 35-36 (Gallica btv1b525245007 canvases 79-81; DECODE R9453)

plaintext.source: key slip f. 36r bound with the copy

transcription.notes: Copy in clear with code numbers for nine persons/places; the 26 code numbers listed in text order in codes.txt (14 Oct 2026), the key slip in key.txt.

system.summary: A small name code: nine numbers (1-53) for persons, towns and provinces in a copy otherwise in clear, with its key bound on the next leaf.
system.notes: Not the two-digit alphabet of nos. 24/25/60 (champagne1590): there 35 = a, 37 = c, 53 = i; here 35 = Mayenne, 37 = M. de Nemours, 53 = Saint-Sorlin. The two dual entries (15 villes de l'Union or Provence & Dauphine; 17 duc de Parme or Picardie) are read from context.

prior_solution.where: the key slip bound after the copy, f. 36r; the copy itself is in clear except the code numbers

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code and posed the catalogue task via a parent agent. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Tomokiyo's nevers.htm and GL.htm, DECODE list for fr. 3623/3625; no prior reading; DECODE gives folios.
Gallica thumbnails of both volumes; contact sheets; full-resolution pages of ff. 35-41, 88, 111 (fr. 3623) and ff. 10, 16 (fr. 3625).
No. 23: key slip on f. 36r transcribed; every code number in the letter resolves.
The 26 code numbers of ff. 35r-v listed in text order from the full-resolution images (codes.txt); all nine values occur on the key slip f. 36r (key.txt).

Entry split from champagne1590 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): no. 23's name code (35 = Mayenne, 37 = M. de Nemours, 53 = Saint-Sorlin) conflicts with the two-digit alphabet of nos. 24/25/60 (35 = a, 37 = c, 53 = i), so it is a different key.

outcome.method_basis: Every code number in the copy is on the key slip bound with it on f. 36r; the letter was decoded with it.
outcome.fraction_read_source: codes.txt: 26 code numbers in ff. 35r-v, all on the key slip (key.txt): 26 of 26.
outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from champagne1590. The copy is in clear except for nine name codes; it reports the League court in Paris (Madame de Nemours, Saint-Sorlin, the Pope and Spain, Mayenne).

credits.note: key slip bound with the copy, BnF fr. 3623 f. 36r
